previous.description: Wise Owl Demeanor (known as Demeanor for .NET, Enterprise Edition through 5.x) is the original .NET obfuscator, shipping since 1999. Then it obfuscates: renames identifiers, encrypts strings, constants, and resources, obfuscates control flow, and injects anti-tamper and anti-debug protections. Per-company Enterprise licensing — one annual key, unlimited developers and build agents, no phone-home, no machine locking, no activation server. Optional Large Language Model (LLM) integration via a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) server lets customers who already use an MCP-capable AI assistant — Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue.dev — drive the audit as a conversation; runs locally over stdio.
